params.body:
The labs at Bakoteh Proper, Albreda and Njaba Kunda were funded by Rotary Global Grant 2016052, a project of Rotary Club Beveren-Waas and the Rotary Club of Banjul. Energy Assistance and Intix funded the same labs beside the grant. On `/deployments` their cards only said "Rotary", inside the school's story.

## What changes

- **A "Funded by" credit on the three cards**, in English, Dutch and French: the grant, both clubs, Energy Assistance and Intix. It is a small grey line under the school's story, with the emblems of both clubs in front of it. The Beveren-Waas emblem links to the club's website.
  - The emblems come from the grant's own newsletter (no. 08).
  - Intix no longer exists, so it is named without a logo. Energy Assistance is named without one until we have their logo file.
- **The school's story no longer names the funders**, so they are not said twice. The stories on the site come from Sanity. The fallback copies in the pages are changed to match. The three descriptions in Sanity have to be changed by hand, see below.
- **Photo height on a computer.** The longer text made these cards taller than their 16:10 photo, which left a white band under the photo. The photo now fills the card's height, and is never less than 16:10 of its column. On a phone nothing changes.

The three schools are matched by their name in Sanity (`src/lib/rotary.js`). A school renamed there has to be renamed there too.

## After merging: the descriptions in Sanity

Until these are changed, the funders appear both in the story and in the credit.

- **Bakoteh Proper LBS:** One of the biggest lower basic schools in The Gambia, with around 3,000 pupils and 115 teachers. Its 51-seat lab is the largest KUBO lab so far and runs fully on solar power. In September 2026 the first grade starts working on the school platform.
- **Albreda LBS:** A village school of 381 pupils with an early childhood section, on the historic North Bank. Its solar-powered lab brings computer lessons to a community far from the capital. From September 2026 the whole school runs on the platform.
- **Njaba Kunda LBS:** Home to over 400 pupils in the North Bank Region. Its lab put the first computers the school ever had in front of its pupils.

The map on deployments.afrodidact.org reads the same school documents and has no credit line. After this change the funders are not named there.

## Checked

- `npm run build`: the three cards carry the credit in all three languages (data from Sanity).
- `npm run check:built` and `npm test` (29 tests) pass.
- Screenshots on a computer and at phone width, in English, Dutch and French.
params.title: Deployments: who funded the three labs of Rotary Global Grant 2016052
